xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Department of Legal Metrology, Government of Uttar Pradesh (Senior Inspector of Legal Metrology, Prayagraj)
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Compounding fees of Rs. 10,000 for violation of The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Violation of Section 18(1)/36(1) of The Legal Metrology Act, 2009 and Rule 7 of The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: There is no material impact on the financial, operations and/ or other activities of the Company due to the Order.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: In continuation to the Show Cause Notice dated September 26, 2025 and the subsequent submissions made by the Company, the State Taxes Officer has passed an order (the said order) under section 73(9) of the State Goods and Services Act, 2017, read with Central Goods and Services Act, 2017 alleging availment of excess Input Tax Credit (ITC) claimed in GSTR-3B vis-a-vis accrued in GSTR-2A for the financial year 2021-22.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: The Company has received the said order for mismatch in ITC claimed, wherein the demand for Goods and Service Tax (GST) for the financial year 2021-22 has been reduced from Rs 22,19,179.86 to Rs 1,00,707. The demand for interest and penalty has also been reduced from Rs 14,32,424 and Rs. 2,21,916 to Rs 78,577 and Rs 10,070 respectively.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr:
The Company is in the process of evaluating the appropriate legal remedy against the order and is proposing to file a response to the same.
There is no material impact on the financial, operations and/ or other activities of the Company due to the said order.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: In continuation to the Intimation dated May 21, 2025 received from State Tax Department. Vapi and with reference to the Show Cause Notice (the said notice) dated September 16, 2025 issued to Micro Wood Private Limited, subsidiary of the Company, under Section 73(5) of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (CSGT Act, 2017), the Assistant Commissioner of State Tax Department, Vapi has passed an order under Section 73(9) of the CGST Act, 2017.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: The said notice was received under Section 73(5) of the CGST Act, 2017, for excess ITC availed/ utilised on B2B supplies and excess claim of ineligible ITC u/s 17(5) for the financial year 2021-22, wherein Goods and Services Tax (GST) amounting to Rs 28,19,562 had been demanded for the financial year 2021-22, along with the interest of Rs 20,10,618 and penalty of Rs 2,81,958. The Company’s subsidiary submitted its reply against the said notice within the prescribed timeline. Post submission of the reply by the Company, the Assistant Commissioner of State Tax Department, Vapi, has issued an order under Section 73(9) of the CSGT Act, 2017 and dropped the proceedings under section 73 of the CGST Act, 2017 and concluded the matter.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: There is no material impact on the financial, operations and/ or other activities of the Company due to the said order.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Assistant Commissioner of Income Tax, Vapi Circle, Vapi
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Ld. Assessing Officer had passed a Rectification Order for Assessment Year 2020-21 (Financial Year 2019-2020), under Section 154 read with Section 143(3) of the Income Tax Act, 1961 ('the Act') and issued a Notice of Demand under Section 156 of the Act wherein the officer has disallowed benefit of concessional rate of tax @ 22% u/s 115BAA. The demand raised is Rs. 6,07,83,850 of which the Company has paid Rs.1,21,56,770 and received stay for the balance amount. The Company has filed an appeal before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) against the said assessment order.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The matter is pending with Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals).
